title: Reproduction Record
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of repro-runner. Locks the exact provenance triple (seed + config_hash + data_hash) required to reproduce a specific run result. All three fields are required and non-null — a repro_record without any of them is not a valid reproduction package.

from_run_record_ref.description: Optional reference to the run_record this repro targets.

seed.description: The fixed random seed used for this reproduction. Required and non-null — a repro without a locked seed is not reproducible.

config_hash.description: Hash of the exact config file used. Required and non-null.

data_hash.description: Hash of the exact dataset used. Required and non-null.

git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the codebase used for this run.

repro_script.description: The runnable script to reproduce the run (emitted as artifact, executed out-of-band).

repro_passed.description: Null until externally executed. True = reproduction matched expected result, False = diverged.

result_delta.description: If repro_passed is False, description of the divergence observed.

notes.description: Any caveats about the reproduction setup (environment, hardware, etc.).
